blocking_conflicts.description: The adopted 2026 QAP PDF identifies itself as a courtesy copy and warns that nonsubstantive differences may exist from the official Texas Administrative Code version; deterministic rules require TAC reconciliation.

TDHCA expressly warns that its public Income and Rent Tool is not definitive and that inaccurate project-specific inputs produce erroneous figures; no statewide row may be activated without property verification.
TDHCA instructions require separate tool runs for each applicable funding source, so LIHTC, HOME, NHTF and bond limits must not be flattened into one result.
The static 2020 Annual Eligibility Certification is a tenant form with restricted program scope and is not the Annual Owner's Compliance Report, which TDHCA requires through CMTS.
The Actual Use method requires property-specific samples, utility-provider evidence, rent roll data and TDHCA review; its guide cannot supply a generic allowance.

enterprise_boundary: Only blank official forms and adopted public guidance belong in this shared pack. Completed tenant certifications, owner reports, Forms 8609, carryover agreements, LURAs, CMTS submissions, utility schedules, waivers and inspection records remain enterprise/property records.
